_comment: Tao model configuration. Edit to swap providers/models for each role.

_providers.claude: Claude Max subscription — free. No key needed.
_providers.openai: OPENAI_API_KEY in ~/.zshenv — OpenAI direct. Per-token cost. Default model: gpt-4o.
_providers.groq: GROQ_API_KEY in ~/.zshenv — Groq LPU inference, very fast. Per-token cost. Default model: llama-3.3-70b-versatile.
_providers.codex: Codex CLI companion — OpenAI subscription quota, no per-token cost. Requires codex plugin.
_providers.ollama: Local inference, no cloud cost. ollama pull deepseek-r1:70b && ollama serve
_providers.gemini: GEMINI_API_KEY in ~/.zshenv — Google direct. Per-token cost.
